question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

FARSIGHTED
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Unwise'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word **FARSIGHTED** means to have "foresight or a good judgment, being able to see distant things with clarity."

 
 
• **Example**: Good feedback enables the companies to make **farsighted** assessments.
 
 
 
• The **antonyms** of the given word are half-baked, unwise, stupid, shortsighted.

So according to the meanings of the given words, the correct answer is **Option 3 i.e. Unwise.**
